name: sense
description: Keep private guidance for important choices available across AI tools.

interface.shortDescription: Keep guidance for important choices private
interface.longDescription: Sense keeps a small set of user-controlled guidance for important choices that recur in different contexts. Current requests and sources take priority, project facts remain with their projects, and continuing source-linked questions remain in Corpus. Sense data stays on this Mac across plugin updates.
